## Profit by Class

A profit and loss split by class for a range of months (`fromMonth`, `toMonth`; `fromDate` and `toDate` are computed).

### Queries
- `accounts`: `linksToMany(LedgerAccount)`, to classify each account as income, cost of goods sold or expense.
- `bills`, `openings`, `invoices`: posted `Bill`, `OpeningBalances` and `Invoice` cards dated in the range; their `ledgerLines` are read directly.
- `journal`: `JournalMonth` cards in the range, whose `ledgerLines` hold every other kind of posting; lines are filtered to the date range.

### Computed
`rows` (`ClassRow`: `cls`, `incomeMinor`, `cogsMinor`, `expenseMinor`, `netMinor`) groups every P&L line by its `cls` tag, with untagged lines under `(none)`, sorted by class. `netIncomeMinor` totals the rows, so it matches the profit and loss for the same months.

The card has no operations.

```ts
import { ProfitByClass } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/accounting/ledger-dimensions';
```

### Non-goals
No grouping by location, no class hierarchy roll-up, and no allocation of untagged overhead.

### Example
`Reports/pnl-by-class-2026`, the full year 2026.
attributes.cardDescription: Profit and loss by class for a range of months, computed from the posted documents and journal lines.
